payload.name: Preserve Existing Facts When Enriching Memories
payload.description: When updating or merging an existing memory with new details during CRUD, or when building an enrichment candidate during extraction.
content: During CRUD, when an UPDATE or MERGE has update_type 'enrichment', retain all existing explicit facts already stored in the memory (names, counts, dates, locations, etc.) unless the new message directly contradicts them.
Combine the new details with the old content instead of replacing it; only drop a previously stored fact when the latest message explicitly says it changed or was wrong.

During extraction, when drafting a candidate that targets an existing memory, include the existing memory's durable facts along with the newly stated attributes, so the subsequent CRUD update does not lose them.

solves: Prevents memory updates from silently dropping previously captured facts when new related details are added. For example, when a later message adds breed information about a person's pets, the update should preserve the already-stored pet names rather than replacing them with only the new attributes.
